script_version: build_seed_gpkg.py v1.0 + manual tie-line strip + manual rings-layer drop
patch_note: v3.0 → v3.1: removed all MV_TIE_LINE components (700), TIE-role breakers (350) and their 1,400 is_closed=false topology_edges via direct SQL DELETE against the built gpkg (components/topology_edges layers). No other data touched. Manevra/switching was already fully removed from the codebase; these normally-open backup lines had no write path left to ever close them, so they were dropped outright rather than kept as inert data. v3.1 → v3.2: dropped the 'rings' layer (108 rows) from the gpkg entirely via `DROP TABLE rings` (GDAL/GPKG driver, registry-clean). It was never loaded by 02-insert.ts (no network.rings table exists since Faz 10) and 03-validate.ts special-cased skipping it — both the data and that skip-case are now gone. source_file_hashes below describe the original v3.0 upstream CSVs (unchanged on disk) — the gpkg itself was hand-patched after the v3.0 build rather than rebuilt from those sources, so it no longer regenerates bit-for-bit from a plain script run against them.
